en: An illustrated postcard showing a large hilltop complex of castle‑like buildings with multiple towers and terraced structures rising above dense green trees. The structure stands on a rocky outcrop overlooking a body of water, with mountains and a small settlement visible in the distant background. The style is soft, in muted pastel colors, resembling an early‑20th‑century drawing or watercolor.
